title: Let service make your life weighty
summary: This meets the dull feeling that nothing you do is reaching beyond maintenance. The line says service to the Lord is fruitful and honors the one who lives from it.
takeaway: Make service the work that outlives you.
lifeApplication: Before calling the day pointless, take up one task as service rather than as burden. Let fruitfulness return through offering, not mood.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes fruitful when the whole life is offered through it.
source.lifeApplication: When the day feels thin, do the next task as service.

evidence.coreClaim: Service becomes fruitful when the whole life is offered through it.
evidence.turn: The path becomes visible when service turns fruitful.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before calling the day pointless, take up one task as service rather than as burden. Let fruitfulness return through offering, not mood.
